evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: you only pay for the actual time use on the move

top_strength: Proactively flagged that a Saturday-afternoon slot likely wasn't enough time for a full-house move and steered the customer to a morning slot instead of just taking the request at face value.
coaching_note: Covered the on-time guarantee but never named a distinct communication promise (day-before call, named crew lead, inbox updates) — that's a full miss on one of the two Stage 2 takeaway items.
